department: Faculty of Mechanical Science and Engineering

eligibility_profile.required_previous_degree: High school diploma for basic Diplom, or B.Sc. for Diplom (Aufbaustudium)
eligibility_profile.ranking_or_selection: Direct admission often possible if formal requirements met

cost_profile.source_notes: No tuition fees, standard semester fee approx 300 EUR.

scholarship_profile.funding_notes: Refer to scholarships_info for details. Most international students rely on DAAD or Deutschlandstipendium, as BAföG is restricted.

housing_sentiment.en: Affordable and relatively easy housing compared to western German cities.
housing_sentiment.tr: Batı Almanya şehirlerine kıyasla uygun fiyatlı ve nispeten kolay konut imkanı.

labs: Institute of Lightweight Engineering and Polymer Technology (ILK)

research_strength_summary.en: Strong research in space systems and lightweight engineering, integrated within a traditional 5-year Diplom structure.
research_strength_summary.tr: Geleneksel 5 yıllık Diplom yapısına entegre edilmiş uzay sistemleri ve hafif mühendislik alanında güçlü araştırmalar.

ecosystem_notes.en: Strong connections to DLR and regional aviation initiatives (OST4Aviation) for sustainable and hybrid-electric aviation.
ecosystem_notes.tr: DLR ve sürdürülebilir ve hibrit elektrikli havacılık için bölgesel havacılık girişimleri (OST4Aviation) ile güçlü bağlantılar.

source_profile.verification_notes: TU Dresden offers a Diplom rather than a standard Master's in Aerospace. A standalone Master is reportedly planned for 2027.

best_for: Students wanting a traditional integrated Diplom with mechanical engineering breadth
not_ideal_for: Students who want a 2-year English M.Sc. directly in aerospace

main_strengths.en: Unique Diplom degree equivalent to MSc
main_strengths.tr: Yüksek lisansa eşdeğer benzersiz Diplom derecesi

main_strengths.en: Strong student teams like STAR Dresden
main_strengths.tr: STAR Dresden gibi güçlü öğrenci takımları

main_risks.en: Diplom structure might be less flexible than a standard MSc
main_risks.tr: Diplom yapısı, standart bir yüksek lisanstan daha az esnek olabilir

decision_summary.application_reality: Straightforward admission if language and degree prerequisites are met.
decision_summary.overall_recommendation: Good choice for those seeking a German-taught Diplom program.

scholarships_info.name: DAAD Scholarships (Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst)
scholarships_info.eligibility: International students (non-EU and EU). Eligibility depends on specific program calls, home country, and academic level.
scholarships_info.amount: Monthly stipend (usually ~934 EUR for Master's), health insurance, travel allowance.
scholarships_info.notes: Highly competitive. Must apply well in advance, often a year before studies begin.

scholarships_info.name: Deutschlandstipendium
scholarships_info.provider: German Federal Government and Private Sponsors
scholarships_info.eligibility: All enrolled students (including international) demonstrating outstanding academic achievement and social engagement.
scholarships_info.amount: 300 EUR per month (150 from govt, 150 from private sponsors).
scholarships_info.notes: Awarded directly by the university. Usually lasts for at least two semesters.

scholarships_info.name: BAföG (Bundesausbildungsförderungsgesetz)
scholarships_info.eligibility: Mainly for German citizens and EU nationals. Non-EU international students are generally NOT eligible unless specific long-term residency conditions are met.
scholarships_info.amount: Varies by income. Half is a grant, half is a zero-interest loan.
scholarships_info.notes: International students should not rely on this unless they have permanent residency.

eligibility_profile.required_previous_degree: B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or related

language_profile.mixed_language_warning: Mainly German, some electives in English.

cost_profile.source_notes: No tuition fees, semester contribution approx 340 EUR.

scholarship_profile.funding_notes: Refer to scholarships_info for details. Most international students rely on DAAD or Deutschlandstipendium, as BAföG is restricted.

housing_sentiment.en: Hamburg is notoriously difficult and expensive for student housing.
housing_sentiment.tr: Hamburg öğrenci yurdu/evleri için oldukça zor ve pahalıdır.

research_strength_summary.en: Exceptional applied research focusing on commercial aviation, cabin systems, and production technology.
research_strength_summary.tr: Ticari havacılık, kabin sistemleri ve üretim teknolojisine odaklanan olağanüstü uygulamalı araştırmalar.

ecosystem_notes.en: Hamburg is a premier global aviation hub, providing unparalleled industry integration and dual study options.
ecosystem_notes.tr: Hamburg, benzersiz endüstri entegrasyonu ve ikili eğitim seçenekleri sunan önde gelen bir küresel havacılık merkezidir.

deadlines.en: June 1st – July 15th (Winter Semester), December 1st – January 15th (Summer Semester)
deadlines.tr: 1 Haziran - 15 Temmuz (Kış Dönemi), 1 Aralık - 15 Ocak (Yaz Dönemi)

source_profile.verification_notes: Some fields require official source verification.

best_for: Students interested in civil aviation and systems engineering

main_strengths.en: Incredible ecosystem for commercial aviation with Airbus and Lufthansa Technik
main_strengths.tr: Airbus ve Lufthansa Technik ile ticari havacılık için inanılmaz bir ekosistem

main_strengths.en: Strong focus on cabin systems and aircraft production
main_strengths.tr: Kabin sistemleri ve uçak üretimine güçlü odak

main_strengths.en: Dual study options available with cooperating companies
main_strengths.tr: İşbirliği yapılan şirketlerle ikili eğitim seçenekleri mevcuttur

main_risks.en: Very tough and expensive housing market
main_risks.tr: Çok zor ve pahalı konut piyasası

main_risks.en: Less focus on space systems compared to aeronautics
main_risks.tr: Havacılığa kıyasla uzay sistemlerine daha az odak

decision_summary.application_reality: Accessible if German and B.Sc. requirements are met.
decision_summary.overall_recommendation: Outstanding choice for aeronautics/aviation in Germany.
